other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste family.
Livestock must be owned by the applicant.
Livestock must be one of milch buffaloes, milch cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, pack animals, or camels.
Animals must be reared within Haryana.
Livestock units established under the “Scheme for Providing Employment Opportunities to Scheduled Castes” are automatically eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides free insurance coverage for livestock owned by Scheduled Caste families, covering various species and associated veterinary costs.
